FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Have questions about our graphic design services? We've got answers.

FAQcard.title: What file formats will I receive?
FAQcard.description: We deliver all final files in formats suitable for print and digital use — typically AI, EPS, SVG (vector), plus PNG and JPG (raster). You'll own all files and full rights to the designs.

FAQcard.title: How many revision rounds are included?
FAQcard.description: Our standard packages include 3 revision rounds. We work collaboratively to ensure the final design exceeds your expectations. Additional revisions can be arranged if needed.

FAQcard.title: Do you offer rush delivery?
FAQcard.description: Yes, we offer priority design services for tight deadlines. Rush pricing applies and depends on the scope and complexity of the project.

FAQcard.title: What information do you need to start a logo project?
FAQcard.description: We start with a design brief covering your brand values, target audience, industry, competitors, preferred style, and any color or style references you like or want to avoid.

FAQcard.title: Can you design for both print and digital?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We design with both print and digital outputs in mind, ensuring your visuals look perfect whether on a business card, billboard, or smartphone screen.
